summary: Practise hot-work controls, fire-system readiness and incident planning for hydrocarbon operations. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Oil and gas fire safety training helps operations, maintenance and response professionals identify ignition hazards and prepare for hydrocarbon fire incidents. Participants practise hot-work permit reviews and fire-protection checks, then map alarm responses and coordinate incident actions. Exercises include impairment controls and fire-brigade handovers.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who make or support fire prevention and emergency-response decisions at hydrocarbon sites, including production, processing, maintenance and fire-team operations.
outcomes: Fire and Gas Detection System Compliance
prerequisites: Prior experience in oil and gas operations, maintenance, fire safety or emergency response is recommended. You should be familiar with basic site safety controls and operational work permits. No coding or specialist software is required.
